newsitem.title: USA: FBI director deals with sons over police prank.
newsitem.headline: FBI director deals with sons over police prank.

text.p: A prank by his sons resulted in the police rushing to FBI Director Louis Freeh's home in Virginia a year ago, prompting the law enforcement officer to dish out some discipline.

Freeh, the father of five boys, recounted Thursday how the older boys sent their 3-year-old brother into the basement, setting off a motion-detector device monitored by the police. The older boys watched at the window as the police cars arrived.
"They don't do it anymore," Freeh told reporters. The former federal judge and prosecutor said he dealt with the boys with a "draconian lack of due process."
